facts.text: Run fast, Frank, and eat what you can. Tomorrow is a long way off.
facts.why: The quote page lists Archy's real lines (such as 'I'll see you when I see you.') and not this one. It is printed in quote marks and reads as invented.
facts.fix: Use a note: Frank, eat what you can and keep your legs ready. We have a long way to go.

fix_note.text: Frank, eat what you can and keep your legs ready. We have a long way to go.

facts.text: Frank and Archy on leave in Cairo
facts.why: Wikipedia has Frank and Archy shipped separately. Frank drinks in Cairo with his mates, and the two only meet again on a training exercise near the Pyramids.
facts.fix: Frank and Archy meet again near the pyramids

facts.why: No stopwatch race appears in the plot or script. Frank and Archy race at the athletics carnival, and Archy wins.

vibe.verdict: A solid wartime mess with Jack's steel springs, the pyramids and the Nek, held back by a pale poster and cent prices.
